%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Common Code Listing Styles
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

\definecolor{listing-comment}{rgb}{0.68,0.68,0.68}
\definecolor{listing-string}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.5}%
\definecolor{listing-keyword-traits}{rgb}{0.75, 0, 0}% traits
\definecolor{listing-keyword-types}{rgb}{0, 0.5, 0}% primitive types
\definecolor{listing-keyword-const}{rgb}{0, 0.5, 0}% type and value constructors
\definecolor{listing-keyword-macro}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.75}% macros
\definecolor{listing-keyword}{rgb}{0, 0, 0}% macros
\definecolor{listing-identifier}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.75}% macros

% the basic style for the code listings
\newcommand{\lstbasicstyle}{\ttfamily\footnotesize}

% style for list numbering
\newcommand{\lstnumberstyle}{\tiny\color{gray}}

% keyword style
\newcommand{\lstkeywordstyle}{\bfseries\color{listing-keyword}}

%

\lstdefinestyle{common}
{
  %
  % 4.3.2 Space and placement
  %
  %
  %
  % 4.3.3 The printed range
  %
  % start line enumeration with line 1000
  firstnumber=1
  %
  %
  %
  % 4.3.5 Figure out the appearance%
  %
  % the size of the fonts that are used for the code
  , basicstyle=\lstbasicstyle
  % identifier style
  , identifierstyle=\color{listing-identifier}
  % comment style
  , commentstyle=\itshape\color{listing-comment}
  % string literal style
  , stringstyle=\color{listing-string}
  % keyword style
  , keywordstyle=\lstkeywordstyle
  %
  %
  % 4.3.6 Getting all characters right
  %
  % lets you use non-ASCII characters; for 8-bits encodings only, does not work with UTF-8
  , extendedchars=false
  % sets default tabsize to 2 spaces
  , tabsize=2
  % show tabs within strings adding particular underscores
  , showtabs=false
  % show spaces everywhere adding particular underscores; it overrides 'showstringspaces'
  , showspaces=false
  % underline spaces within strings only
  , showstringspaces=false
  %
  %
  % 4.3.7 Line numbers
  %
  % where to put the line-numbers; possible values are (none, left, right)
  , numbers=left
  % the step between two line-numbers. If it's 1, each line will be numbered
  , stepnumber=2
  % The first line of each listing gets numbered
  , numberfirstline=false,
  % the style that is used for the line-numbers
  , numberstyle=\lstnumberstyle
  % how far the line-numbers are from the code
  , numbersep=5pt
  %
  %
  % 4.3.8 Captions
  %
  % a title without any numbering or label.
  % , title= asdf,
  % the caption of the listing
  % , caption = {[short]asdt},
  % % the label of the listing
  %, label = asdf,
  % sets the caption-position to bottom
  , captionpos=b
  %
  %, abovecaptionskip = \smallskipamount
  %, belowcaptionskip = \smallskipamount
  %
  %
  % 4.3.9 Margins and line shape
  %
  % sets automatic line breaking
  , breaklines=true
    % sets if automatic breaks should only happen at whitespace
  , breakatwhitespace=true
  % the auto indent for beaks
  , breakautoindent=true
  %
  %
  % 4.3.10 Frames
  %
  % draws a frame none|leftline|topline|bottomline|lines|single|shadowbox
  , frame=none
  % if not set, the frame-color may be changed on line-breaks within not-black text
  , rulecolor=\color{black}
  %
  %
  % 4.3.12 Column alignment
  %
  % column alignment fixed, flexible, spaceflexible, or fullflexible
  , columns=[c]fixed
  % keeps spaces in text, useful for keeping indentation of code (possibly needs columns=flexible)
  , keepspaces=true
  %
  %
  % if you want to add LaTeX within your code (*@\label{comment}@*)
 , escapeinside={(*@}{@*)}
}

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Language Specific Options
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% C Style Definition
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


\lstdefinestyle{coloredC}
{
  % set the langauge
  language=C
  % set the base style
  , style = common
  %
  % if you want to delete keywords from the given language
  % , deletekeywords={...}
  % if you want to add more keywords to the set
  , morekeywords={uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t, inline}
  % some additional comments
  , morecomment=[l]{\//},
}

\lstnewenvironment{codec}
  {\lstset{style=coloredC}}
  {}

\lstnewenvironment{codecfloat}
  {\lstset{style=coloredC,float=ht}}
  {}
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\lstdefinestyle{cpp}{
  language=C++,
  morekeywords={constexpr, node_id, noexcept, node, edge, weight, NodeCursor, EdgeCursor, InCursor, OutCursor, table_iterator, next(), prev(), search(), GraphAPI, WT_CURSOR, WT_SESSION, WT_CONNECTION, WT_CONFIG_ITEM, mmap, get_outnbd_iter(), set_key_range(), create_graph_handle(), GraphEngine, GraphBase },
  breaklines=true,
  % postbreak=\mbox{\textcolor{red}{$\hookrightarrow$}\space},
}
